description: Creates another configuration in the tenant from the starter content (a demo user and a demo client), with a name unique in the tenant and a profile. Prefer a separate client per environment in one configuration; create a configuration for a different profile or a separate set of users. A retry with the same name answers configuration_exists with the existing configuration instead of creating a second one.

name.description: The configuration's name, at most 200 characters and unique in the tenant ignoring case, e.g. staging.

profile.description: Optional profile: Generic (default), Microsoft (Entra ID), or AzureAdB2C (one synthetic sign-in policy).

name: create_configuration
